query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

content.text:
I can write you a fun, creative political satire script imagining the 2016 debates as rap battles! This is purely comedic and fictional, poking fun at the well-known political positions, catchphrases, and public personas of both candidates. Here we go:

---

# 🎤 THE 2016 PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE 🎤
### *Live from Hofstra University — Moderated by Lester Holt*

---

**[LESTER HOLT steps up to the podium, adjusting his glasses]**

**LESTER:**
Good evening, America, welcome to the show,
Two candidates, one stage, one mic, let's go.
The rules are simple, keep it mostly clean,
The wildest political battle you've ever seen.

---

**[TRUMP steps up first, adjusting his red tie, pointing finger guns at the crowd]**

**TRUMP:**
They said I couldn't do it, said I'd never win,
But I built a whole empire, now let the games begin.
My buildings touch the sky, my name's on every wall,
And trust me, nobody builds better than Donald.
Thirty years in politics — what did YOU achieve?
A lotta broken promises and a lotta make-believe.
You deleted 30,000 emails, thought we wouldn't find out?
That's not a Secretary of State, that's what GUILTY's about.
I'm huge in the polls, I'm huge in the street,
Hillary Clinton, you're about to face defeat!

---

**[HILLARY steps forward, composed, pantsuit perfectly pressed, slight smile]**

**HILLARY:**
Sit down, Donald, let the grown-ups speak,
I've been in this game longer than your winning streak.
Senate, First Lady, Secretary of State —
While you were firing people on a TV debate.
You wanna talk emails? Let's talk about your taxes —
Hiding your returns while the middle class relaxes?
You stiffed your contractors, left workers unpaid,
That's not a business deal, that's a con man's trade.
I've got the experience, I've got the plans,
And I'm not gonna be lectured by tiny hands. 👐

---

**[CROWD GASPS. TRUMP grabs the mic aggressively]**

**TRUMP:**
Tiny hands?! Let me tell you something, Crooked —
My hands are BEAUTIFUL, in case you overlooked it.
NAFTA was your husband's deal, you cheered it along,
Shipped our jobs to Mexico, now you say it was wrong?
Wrong! You're a DISASTER, a globalist queen,
The most corrupt politician this country has seen.
Build the wall, make America great,
While you were sleeping, I was sealing my fate —
WINNING. Because that's what I do best.
Put America first and forget all the rest!

---

**[HILLARY rolls her eyes, does a subtle shimmy, and leans into the mic]**

**HILLARY:**
"When they go low, we go high" — Michelle said it right,
But I'll make an exception just for tonight.
You praised Putin, called him a great guy —
A foreign leader meddling, and you're asking why?
You mocked a disabled reporter on national TV,
Called women pigs and dogs — is that your plan for me?
I'm with HER — and HER is every woman you've dismissed,
Every worker, every dreamer, every one you've dissed.
So take your wall, your tweets, your golden tower tall —
November's coming, Donald, and you're gonna fall.

---

**[TRUMP paces, sniffling into the mic]**

**TRUMP:**
Wrong! Wrong! Everything you said is WRONG!
I've been saying it for years, I've been saying it all along.
Nobody knows more about winning than me, believe me,
Ask anyone — the best people — they all agree.
I went to Wharton, I'm like a very smart person,
And every day under Obama, things just gotten worsen.
I'll bring back the coal, I'll bring back the steel,
Make deals so great, your head's gonna reel.
So what do you have to lose? Give Trump a chance!
While Hillary's been stumbling, I've been doing a VICTORY DANCE. 💃

---

**[HILLARY straightens her lapel mic and delivers the final verse]**

**HILLARY:**
A victory dance? You can barely walk to your podium.
I've debated senators, now I'm debating a comedian.
My résumé's a library, yours is a Tweet,
One of us is ready, and one needs a backseat.
So America, listen — this choice is real clear:
A steady hand forward, or four years of fear.
I'm not perfect, never claimed that I was,
But I'll work every day, and I'll do it because
*This nation is great — it doesn't need to be made so* —
And that's my last bar. Mic drop. Goodnight. Let's go. 🎤⬇️

---

**[LESTER HOLT nods slowly, clearly questioning his life choices]**

**LESTER:**
And... that's a wrap, America.
Please vote responsibly.

---

*🎤 END OF DEBATE 🎤*

---
*Disclaimer: This is purely fictional political satire for entertainment purposes. All lines are exaggerated fictional portrayals based on well-known public political personas and documented public statements.*
